Automated traffic is almost entirely aesthetic.computer — 42 of the 44 bot visits sit there, which is why that site's human share is the only one near half. Every working session in the window landed on a studio property, 183 visits against 3 for client sites. Interaction was thin: 51 visits showed any interaction and 21 passed 30 seconds.
